description_en: Queries the names of the host accounts that a user group is authorized to manage in a host group
description_zh: 查询指定用户组在指定主机组中已授权的主机账户名称
name: ListHostGroupAccountNamesForUserGroup

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the bastion host on which you want to query the host account names the user group is authorized to manage in a host group.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to query the ID of the bastion host
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询的用户组所在堡垒机的实例ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host on which you want to query the host account names the user group is authorized to manage in a host group.

For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询的用户组所在堡垒机的区域ID。
区域ID和区域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the user group.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/204509.html operation to query the ID of the user group
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询的用户组ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/204509.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: user_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the host group.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/201307.html operation to query the ID of the host group
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询的主机组ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/201307.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: host_group_id
